title: Investor Registration and KYC/AML Verification
description: Verify that an investor can successfully register and complete KYC/AML verification, obtaining credentials linked to a Decentralized Identity (DID).

steps.description: Navigate to investor registration page
Submit valid personal and institutional details
Complete KYC/AML verification process
Check that credentials are issued and linked to a valid DID on ledger
Verify that no PII is stored on-chain and identity is privacy-preserving
Attempt registration with invalid or incomplete data
Verify registration rejection and appropriate error messages

title: Permissioned Domain Access Enforcement
description: Ensure that actions in the protocol are restricted based on credential and jurisdictional rules enforced by XLS-80 permissioned domain.

steps.description: Attempt a fund subscription with valid credentials matching allowed jurisdiction
Verify subscription succeeds
Attempt fund subscription with credentials from disallowed jurisdiction
Verify the transaction is blocked with appropriate compliance violation message
Attempt token transfer with revoked or expired credentials
Verify transfer is rejected and logged

title: Multi-Purpose Token (MPT) Standard Compliance
description: Test MPT token functionalities including configurable supply, transfer fees, authorized holders, and clawbacks function in compliance with XRPL standards.

steps.description: Create MPT token with configured supply and fees
Confirm token creation on ledger with correct parameters
Transfer tokens between authorized holders paying transfer fees
Verify fees are deducted and balances updated correctly
Attempt transfer from unauthorized holder
Confirm transfer is rejected
Execute clawback on tokens from a holder flagged by compliance
Verify clawback succeeds and tokens are returned to issuer

title: Fund Lifecycle Management
description: Validate fund creation, issuance, subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, and compliance-checked transactions.

steps.description: Create a new institutional fund with token issuance
Confirm fund and token appear correctly on ledger and in the dashboard
Investor with valid credentials subscribes to fund shares
Verify subscription transaction passes compliance checks and shares are issued
Investor redeems fund shares
Verify redemption processes correctly with compliance validation and share burn
Attempt fund subscription without valid credentials
Expect rejection due to failed compliance

title: XRPL Decentralized Exchange (DEX) and AMM Trading with Compliance
description: Test authorized investors trading MPT tokens on XRPL DEX and permissioned AMM liquidity pools enforcing real-time compliance.

steps.description: Investor with valid credentials trades tokens on XRPL DEX
Verify trade executes successfully and on-chain logs record compliance status
Investor participates in permissioned AMM liquidity pool
Verify liquidity provision and share token distribution with compliance checks
Investor with revoked credentials attempts trade
Verify trade is denied with compliance breach notification

title: Lending Protocol with Credentialed Pooled Lending
description: Validate lending pool operations including authorized borrowers and depositors, tracking repayments, defaults, and interest on-chain.

steps.description: Create a lending pool with credentialed access
Authorized borrower submits loan request
Loan approval is granted after compliance and risk assessment
Depositor invests into lending pool
Depositor balance and pooled fund amounts update correctly
Track repayments and interest accruals on-chain
Ensure repayment status and defaults are accurately reflected
Attempt loan request from unauthorized or non-credentialed user
Confirm loan request is rejected

title: Compliance and Risk Management Enforcement
description: Validate that all transactions pass real-time compliance checks enforcing multi-jurisdictional regulations and that breach actions (revocation, clawback) trigger correctly.

steps.description: Submit a mint transaction for fund tokens with valid credentials
Transaction is approved and logged with compliance metadata
Submit a transfer transaction violating AML rules
Transaction is blocked and compliance agent revokes user credential
Clawback of tokens flagged for suspicious activity is executed and logged
Attempt any transaction for revoked credential user
Verify denial with compliance breach reason

title: Governance via Multi-Signature Control and Upgradeable Contracts
description: Test governance processes including proposal submission, multi-sig confirmations, voting, upgrades, and audit log capture.

steps.description: Submit governance proposal by authorized participant
Proposal is recorded and visible to all governance participants
Perform multi-signature approval process for a contract upgrade
Verify upgrade is executed only after all required signatures
Check that all multisig actions and parameter changes are logged immutably on-chain
Attempt upgrade with insufficient signatures
Confirm upgrade is rejected and no changes occur

title: Security Protocols: HSM/MPC Key Management and Formal Verification of Hooks
description: Ensure security mechanisms including key management integration, formal verification of Hooks, and pre-deployment security audits.

steps.description: Integrate HSM/MPC key management for critical signing operations
Verify keys are never exposed and signing operates correctly
Deploy Hooks only after formal verification process completes successfully
Hooks pass security audits and operate as intended under stress test
Attempt deployment of unverified or failing Hooks
Confirm deployment is blocked with relevant error

title: Cross-Chain Bridge and Oracle Integration Integrity
description: Test secure asset transfer across chains via the bridge and validate reliable oracle price feeds meeting protocol mandates.

steps.description: Initiate asset transfer from XRPL to an EVM chain via bridge
Verify transaction integrity and successful asset receipt on target chain
Fetch asset price from oracle
Verify accuracy, freshness, and secure delivery of price data
Simulate failure or incorrect oracle data feed
Confirm safeguards trigger rejecting suspicious data and prevent incorrect transactions

title: Developer SDKs and API Coverage
description: Validate all core protocol features are exposed via SDKs and APIs with WebSocket, REST, and CLI interfaces supporting institutional workflows.

steps.description: Invoke APIs to list funds, create funds, and query investor portfolios
Ensure correct responses with relevant data and error handling
Use WebSocket for real-time transaction monitoring
Verify timely and reliable event notifications
Execute commands through CLI client for fund and compliance operations
Confirm commands produce expected results and error messages

title: Analytics and Real-Time Reporting Dashboard Accuracy
description: Test analytics dashboards show correct real-time and aggregated on-chain/off-chain data for funds, investors, and compliance status.

steps.description: Generate multiple transactions affecting fund performance and portfolio analytics
Verify dashboards update in real-time reflecting correct AUM, NAV, risk metrics, and compliance reports
Inject edge cases such as compliance breaches or rapid trading events
Ensure reporting handles anomalies correctly and alerts are displayed

title: Audit Logs and Immutable Ledger Evidence Verification
description: Verify immutable on-chain audit logs capture credential issuance, verification, revocation, transactions, compliance decisions, and governance actions.

steps.description: Perform credential issuance and link to DID
Confirm immutable ledger evidence is recorded and accessible
Conduct transactions and governance actions with multisig confirmations
Verify all events are logged chronologically and tamper-proof
Request audit logs filtered by entity type
Ensure logs are complete, consistent, and include compliance and security metadata

title: Error Handling and Edge Case Transactions
description: Test system behavior under invalid inputs, partial failures, revoked credentials, expired tokens, and unexpected network conditions.

steps.description: Submit transactions with invalid or missing parameters
Verify system rejects with clear error messages
Attempt operations with expired or revoked user credentials
Confirm all operations are denied and logged as security events
Simulate network latency or chain reorgs during critical transactions
Ensure transactions either succeed or fail consistently without partial state corruption
